prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1194; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you're comfortable with us recording this conversation?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe where the accident happened.

A: It was at an intersection in Katy, Texas. I was going through a green light on the main road when a car coming from the cross street pulled out in front of me.

Q: Which part of your vehicle was struck?

A: The driver's side. The other car hit me right in the door area, so it was a pretty direct side impact.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did your airbags deploy?

A: The side curtain airbag came out, I think. Everything happened really fast.

Q: Did you go to the hospital or seek medical care afterward?

A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They checked me over and said I had a neck and back strain. I was given muscle relaxers and told to rest.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff, especially when I turn my head to check traffic, and my lower back aches after sitting for a while. I've been going to physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injuries?

A: I missed a few days right after the accident, and I've been on modified duties since then. My doctor has me on a lifting restriction for now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Only that I was driving carefully and I believe the other driver didn't stop at the stop sign. That's what I saw, anyway.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
